title: Recipes are host-invoked contracts bounded by their declared variant
statement: Every recipe MUST have one canonical source whose manifest validates and whose SKILL.md front matter matches it, its host projections MUST be byte copies of that source, an installation MUST refuse as a whole before its first write when a preflight over every target finds a symlink on any installation path or any drifted target, MUST recheck every target and its ancestors again at write time without following links and refuse when one has become a symlink or differs from its preflight observation, and MUST install as one unit that publishes each new file without replacing an existing entry and, on any refusal or failure, removes every file it published and every directory it created that holds no other entry, so the prior set of targets remains, and every typed operation MUST run only as part of a manifest-declared variant of a known recipe, with an effect no wider than the variant, explicit repository-relative write paths inside the variant write scope for any non-read operation, and an existing materialized file with different bytes reported as drift rather than overwritten.
rationale: ADR-GOV-0020 keeps one canonical recipe source with generated projections, and the recipe contract keeps deterministic work in typed operations whose effects and write scopes the declared variant bounds; a recipe that widens its scope would act outside any authorized boundary. The symlink and drift refusal runs twice: a preflight over every target, and a write-time recheck by lstat and no-follow reads against the preflight digests, so a target changed or a link inserted after preflight refuses; the ADR-AUT-0005 no-replace publication and an in-process rollback journal keep a failed installation from leaving a partial set (issue #313). A process crash mid-installation is outside this statement: it can leave a subset of the new files, which a re-run completes because files holding the generated bytes are left unchanged.

strategy.rationale: A deterministic test corpus under tests/ and packages/*/tests observes this obligation; trace links the tests.
